Contact.Form.subtitle: Share your idea, current challenge or existing product. We'll review the details and help define the next practical step.

Contact.GetInTouch.title: WHAT HAPPENS AFTER YOU GET IN TOUCH?
Contact.GetInTouch.description: Our engineering audit process is designed for clarity and speed. We move from initial contact to a concrete technical recommendation within 5 business days.

steps.title: INTERNAL ASSESSMENT
steps.desc: We analyze your brief against our expertise modules. We identify potential technical blockers and architectural opportunities before our first call.

steps.title: DISCOVERY SESSION
steps.desc: A focused 30-minute technical deep-dive. No sales pitch - just engineering talk to understand your stack, timeline, and core goals.

steps.title: ROADMAP & PROPOSAL
steps.desc: You receive a detailed breakdown of how we would build it, including suggested technologies, team structure, and estimated fixed-cost modules.
